steps.label: 1. Split
steps.sub: Cut the training data into k folds

steps.label: 2. Rotate
steps.sub: Hold one fold out, train on the rest

steps.label: 3. Score
steps.sub: Repeat k times, one score per fold

steps.label: 4. Average
steps.sub: Report the mean and the spread

code:
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5,
    shuffle=True, random_state=42)
scores = cross_val_score(pipe, X_tr,
    y_tr, cv=skf, scoring="f1")
print(scores.round(3))
print(scores.mean().round(3),
      scores.std().round(3))
# [0.711 0.808 0.723 0.747 0.659]
# 0.73 0.049
caption: Five scores, not one. The spread is information.

code:
res = cross_validate(pipe, X_tr, y_tr,
    cv=skf, return_train_score=True,
    scoring=["accuracy","recall","f1"])
# test_accuracy  0.846 +/- 0.021
# train_accuracy 0.856
# test_recall    0.692 +/- 0.084
# test_f1        0.730 +/- 0.049
caption: Train and test scores side by side reveal overfitting.

plt.axhline(scores.mean(),
           color="crimson")
plt.xlabel("Fold")
plt.ylabel("F1 score")
plt.title("F1 per fold")
plt.show()
